game_title: Fallback: Type Cast Forge – Sulfur Springs
game_concept: A tower defense set in Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs, steaming sulfur springs: the fire warden must hold off smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Type Cast Forge: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Sulfur Springs: steaming sulfur springs
core_gameplay_loop: In Sulfur Springs, repeat each round: Convert text to numbers with int() or float() before adding, or the forge explodes. Then check forge_heat and advance.
player_objective: Protect the ember furnace from smoke serpents in Sulfur Springs: keep forge_heat above zero until the 41-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 8 (extended tier): Type Cast Forge
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 2, Level 8, Advance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
